SPECIFICATION FOR 
TINES FOR TRACTOR OPERATED CULTIVATORS 

PART 2 S-TYPE TINES

1. Scope— Specifies material, dimensions and other requirements for S-type tines for tractor operated 
cultivators. Three categories, namely, Category 1, Category 2 and Category 3 are specified in this 
standard. 

2. Material— Shall be low alloy steel, preferably conforming to Grade 55 Si21VIn90 of IS : 3431-1982 
'Specification for steel for manufacture of volute, helical and laminated springs for automotive 
suspension ( second revision)'. Any other material having characteristics equivalent to or better than 
this may also be used. 

3. Hardness — 235 to 310. HB [see IS : 1500-1983 Method for Brinell hardness test for metallic 
materials ( second revision ) ]. 

4. Shape \d Dimensions — Shape and the essential dimensions of the three categories of S-type 
tines shall £j#as given in Fig. 1 to 3. The other dimensions shall be declared by the manufacturer.

FIG. 1 S-TYPE TINE, CATEGORY 1, MAIN DIMENSIONS 

5. Clearance Zones — The clearance zones for the three categories of S-type tines shall be as given 
in Fig. 4 to 6. 

6. Other Requirements 

B.I The tines shall be free from cracks, pits, burrs and other visual defects. 

6.2 The tines shall be free from rust and shall have a protective coating which will prevent surface 
deterioration in transit and storage. 

6.3 If the tine is set at its working position and a force of 1 000 N ( 100 kgf ) is applied for two minutes 
at the centre of shovel fixing position, the tine shall not lose its shape.

7. Marking — The S-type tines shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark, if any; 

b) Batch or code number; and 

c) Category. 

7.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

9p Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser, the criteria 
for sampling for lot acceptance shall be done in accordance with 3 of IS : 7201-1974 'Method of 
sampling of agricultural machinery and tractors'. The classification of different requirements of this 
specification for the purpose of lot testing is given in the clauses mentioned below for guidance: 

a) Dimensional and visual requirements — 4, 5, 6.1 and 6.2; and 

b) Other than visual and dimensional requirements — - 2, 3 and 6.3.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The Part 1 of this standard covers the requirements for rigid tines for tractor operated 
cultivators. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from ISO/DP 5678— Equipment 
for working the soil — S-type cultivator tines — Main dimensions and clearance zones issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ).
